question.text: The differential equation of all circles passing through the origin and having their centres on the $x$-axis is

solution.text:
General equation of all such circles is 
$\mathrm{x}^2+\mathrm{y}^2+2 \mathrm{gx}=0$.
Differentiating, we get
$2 \mathrm{x}+2 \mathrm{y} \frac{\mathrm{dy}}{\mathrm{dx}}+2 \mathrm{g}=0$
$\therefore$ Desired equation is
$\begin{aligned}
& x^2+y^2+\left(-2 x-2 y \frac{d y}{d x}\right) x=0 \\
& \Rightarrow y^2=x^2+2 x y \frac{d y}{d x}.
\end{aligned}$
